about:
Great Sky Solar was founded in 2026 and is headquartered at 3 Bow Street in Lexington, Massachusetts. The company operates as a locally focused installer serving the Greater Boston area with solar photovoltaic and heat pump systems.

The firm designs and installs custom solar arrays and electric heat pumps using in-house crews rather than subcontractors. Its process includes a custom design phase, a good-faith agreement with zero deposit, a dedicated project manager, expert installation, and ongoing lifetime system support. To date the team of 10-plus local experts has completed more than 2,980 installations representing over 30 megawatts of installed capacity.

Great Sky Solar works primarily with residential homeowners and commercial property owners in Massachusetts who want to generate their own clean energy. The company references hundreds of neighbors who have switched to solar and highlights installations on both homes and businesses.

The company positions itself as a departure from volume-driven sales models, emphasizing transparent guidance, no-commission advisors, and a 30-year insurance-backed warranty that covers failures, labor costs, and even insolvency risk. Its stated mission is to align clean energy with clean business practices, prioritizing long-term accountability over short-term growth.
